title: First agreements with the tall whites: speak English, sing to announce himself

tellings.quote: agreement I made with them was after realizing they were real that I asked him that whenever they came around me that they talk between themselves.

plain: A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years among tall, pale beings he calls the tall whites while stationed in the desert near Indian Springs, Nevada, between 1965 and 1967, says he made his first agreements with them once he accepted they were real. He tells Michels he asked that whenever they came near him they talk among themselves in English, and that he would sing to let them know he was coming. If true, it would mean a young airman had worked out ground rules for living alongside non-human visitors.
